“You like it, sweetheart? It’s yours! What? It’s an innate spiritual treasure? No problem — I’ll get you a dozen more!”
With maxed-out cultivation and a heaven-defying cutie in tow, he embarks on a lighthearted and hilarious journey to find his wife.
Holy land prodigies?

116761.synopsis:
“What, you guys don’t even watch TV? There’s literally a saint over there performing miracles!”
“But seriously, why does everyone keep calling me a saint??”

117273.synopsis:
Just transmigrated and already exiled to the northern frontier, branded as the family’s most infamous good-for-nothing?
Sigh, it is what it is… Might as well hit the tavern for a drink first…
Wait, who the h**l are these black-armored maniacs that cut down everyone in sight?
And what’s this? A Talent Tree?
【Ding! Your new talent “Magic Immunity” has been activated!】
【Kill enemies to gain combat experience. Unlock Arcblade: Heaven’s Reversal Stance, wielding a massive dual-handed blade to clash head-on with dragons!】
【Craft blueprints to gain technical experience. Hand-build a magitek converter and hit these medieval fools with some dimensional superiority!】
A white-haired elf girl under a deadly curse, no one can get close?
Sorry, I’m the only one allowed to hug and kiss her!
You all say white hair brings disaster—well, that’s exactly my type!
The elf bloodline depends on me to continue!
The Pope calls me a heretic and dares chant forbidden spells in front of me?
Sorry pal, Magic Immunity means I do whatever the h**l I want! You call that damage?
Ghouls? Black Knights? Demon Dragons?
Under heavy firepower, all beings are equal!
【New body talent unlocked: Harlan Fist King! Who doesn’t know about me, Kael Klan?】
【New composure talent unlocked: God’s Eye! Full-map vision, if it’s not off, it’s on.】
…
From this moment on, a steel fortress rises from the northern tundra—
And Klan becomes the one true god of this magitek empire!
associated_names: 北境领主：开局救下精灵少女

120089.synopsis:
A single moment of hesitation shattered their first love—Yoon Jae-ha, unable to express his true feelings, and Han Hye-won, who did her best to avoid him.
One day, both of their lives came to a sudden, tragic end.
But fate offers them a second chance.
“You have no choice but to turn back time. For exactly 49 days.”
“Is there a small regret or mistake you wish you could undo?”
In that moment, both of them were reminded of ‘that’ memory—their clumsy, awkward first kiss.
From that day forward, their relationship fell apart completely.
“It seems the two of you have the same thing in mind.”
For 49 days, they are sent back in time—to that moment—to rewrite the past.
But things don’t go quite as planned.
They wake up in the past, only to realize they’ve swapped bodies—and they’re both 19 years old again.
“You’re the one who said we could never be more than friends. But now? What’s this supposed to mean?”
“You’re a woman to me. I’m not doing this ‘just friends’ thing.”
A chaotic, time-travel romance between two switched souls!
Hye-won, quirky but loveable, and Jae-ha, quiet but dangerously possessive, find their feelings for each other deepening.
As unexpected people entangle themselves in their fate, the lines between past and present blur.
When the 49 days are up…
‘Can this love finally come true?’

120345.synopsis:
She secluded herself in the mountains, whiling away the time, and reached the pinnacle of both ancient and modern times.
Only, she didn’t even realize it.

123929.synopsis:
A zombie virus outbreak has brought the world to ruin!
The male lead, Qin Feng, gets trapped in a girls’ university dorm while helping the campus belle move her luggage!
Outside the dorm, zombies roar. Inside, there’s nothing but cries of despair.
Just when Qin Feng thinks he’s going to starve to death…
【Ding! Infinite Buffet Space successfully bound!】
【Starter Pack: Deluxe Seafood Buffet Area unlocked! Boston lobsters, king crab legs, foie gras… unlimited supply!】
Qin Feng stared blankly at the luxurious restaurant inside his portable space—and the cheerful flight attendant-style waitresses bouncing around inside.
“What the h*ll, why should I be afraid of zombies now?”
While the pure-hearted campus belle next door is seeing stars from hunger, scheming over half a slice of bread…
Qin Feng is in the restaurant, elegantly slicing into a medium-rare steak, while a curvy flight attendant personally pours his wine.
【Ding! Host has successfully fed campus belle Lin Yuwei. Intimacy +20! Dessert area unlocked!】
【Ding! Host has conquered the cool and aloof Tang Tang with gourmet food. Acquired: Special Experience Card x1! Space energy +100!】
The guys from the male dorm across the building glare with green eyes, shouting in rage:
“Qin Feng! Give me back my girlfriend! You can’t force her just for a bite to eat!”
Qin Feng looked calmly at the starving, skin-and-bones guys in the opposite dorm and smiled slightly:
“Sorry, I didn’t force her. Your girlfriend is now my personal chef and… bodyguard.”
In the apocalypse, food is the only true currency.
And I… own the world!
associated_names: 困在女大宿舍，我空间有自助餐厅

126233.synopsis:
Julietta, waiting for her fiancé Ivan who went off to war.
Four years later, news arrives that Ivan is returning, and for a brief, happy moment, Julietta believes she will finally marry him. But her joy is short-lived—her father is suddenly accused of mu*dering Ivan’s entire family and takes his own life.
Overwhelmed by grief and shock, Julietta is sure she’ll be cast aside, expecting Ivan to break off their engagement.
But instead, Ivan insists on proceeding with the marriage, even though she is the daughter of the man who killed his family.
“We’re going to get married as planned.”
“I mean for you to spend the rest of your life at my side, atoning for your father’s sins.”
Driven by Ivan’s demand and her love for him, Julietta eventually agrees to the marriage—only for Ivan’s possessiveness and obsession to tighten their hold around her…
What are Ivan’s true feelings for Julietta?
And was her father really a mu*derer?

135705.synopsis:
“Sorry. I like someone else.”
That was the fifteenth time the male lead dumped the female lead,
the fifteenth time I had failed,
and the fifteenth time I was left guessing the identity of that “someone” he liked.
And so began yet another month — the sixteenth round.
“Don’t get distracted by some other woman.”
Because you’re supposed to live happily with the female lead.
“Just look at me. Only me.”
Because you shouldn’t be eyeing anyone else.
“Look not at the person you like, but at the person who likes you.”
Because that’s the only way you’ll give up your mysterious crush and accept the female lead’s confession.
I worked so hard to keep the male lead close… so how did things end up like this?
“I’m saying… I like you, Sunbae.”
What? Me? Why?

206617.synopsis:
Yong Cheonha, the youngest young master of the Yongmun Clan and an Alpha-crazed, face-obsessed fiend.
His goal is one and only one: to have his first time with a stunningly gorgeous Alpha.
But Yong Cheonha, whose purity was forcibly sealed away by his impossibly high visual standards, meets, with unbelievable timing, the delicate beauty Alpha Chae Songhwa, who satisfies his tastes 10000%, and the two become partners who exchange pheromones and share skinship…
“It was dark, so what could you even see from that distance? There were so many people, and everyone was wearing the same clothes…”
“I recognized you at a glance.”
Yong Cheonha said it completely matter-of-factly. His expression showed he was not offering empty flattery, only stating facts. He was as calm as if declaring propositions and truths like “gravity exists” or “human life is finite.”
“You were all I could see, hyung. For me.”
***
“I want to date you, hyung.”
The handsome bottom who meant to keep things casual but ended up hooked,
“What we have been doing is not dating?”
And the beautiful top who was already dating him. The chaotic, fumbling romance of a beauty top and a face-obsessed bottom!
An Evenly Matched Romance!
